'''Onoru''' was a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] who voted for [[Rokari Kem]] at the election of the new Galactic Alliance [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] in [[44 ABY]].
